overlay_text: tetragonal only: the 27 printed pairs recomputed in collision_phase2_check.py (collision_phase2_results.json) resolve their rows: SAME TYPE -> COLLISION; DIFFERENT TYPE on an unstored (`unres`) row removes that row from the type's unresolved set; `other` pairs are already resolved by the store
rule_source: collision_phase2_hex_check.py lines 115-139 (store-side screen), re-implemented as a pure function; equivalence asserted on the hexagonal family
rule_text: SURVIVOR = in every sighted group the f-vector is absent from the printed table or every printed row with that (group, f) reproduced (P2) as a different stored type; COLLISION = the type reproduces one of his printed cells (S-cell / SAME); UNRESOLVED = a printed row with that (group, f) was not stored (quarantined in the sweep), so no type-level statement is possible for that pair. Rows are matched to stored P2 cells by (group, printed point, b-ratio): exact printed_point_Bpp in the hexagonal store, point mod 1 in the tetragonal store (triage_phase2.py frac_key; the tetragonal store keeps the printed point verbatim in `point`).
